name: risk_analysis
description: Scores each plan step for risk on { likelihood: 0-1, impact: 0-1, reversibility: 0-1, blast_radius: count }. Computes a risk_class (low|medium|high|critical) and a mitigation. High/critical steps require an explicit operator gate before execution (Law 4 rollback_Aways).

outputs.name: risk_report
outputs.description: { per_step: [{ step_id, likelihood, impact, reversibility, blast_radius, risk_class, mitigation }], overall_risk_class, blocking_steps[] }

side_effects: Persists risk_report alongside the plan in memory module

error_codes.message: A step has reversibility=0 (irreversible) and impact above threshold.
error_codes.recovery: Refuse to mark the plan approved; require an explicit operator gate + a documented rollback strategy per Law 4.

error_codes.message: risk_analysis received a step_id not present in the plan.
error_codes.recovery: Skip and log; return partial report with a warning.

examples: db_migration with no backup + irreversibility -> risk_class=critical -> blocking_steps=[step_id], required gate operator_approve.
